scenarios.assert: grep -qiE 'nothing to distill|no distillation candidates|no candidate' result.txt
scenarios.judge: The response runs the distillation flow on a machine with no recurring workflow evidence. It must conclude there is nothing to distill (candidates require a task class seen in >=2 sessions) rather than fabricate a skill. Penalize any attempt to scaffold or propose a skill without >=2-session evidence, and any skill written directly to disk (this flow only stages proposals).

positive: distill a skill from this workflow
turn how I keep doing this into a skill
extract a reusable skill from my past sessions
negative: what do you know about me
